info.title: OpenDeX Backend API
info.summary: Local control API of the OpenDeX backend (Android multi-window mirroring).
info.description:
The local control API of the **OpenDeX backend** — the process that drives an Android phone over `adb` and the patched
scrcpy server, and that the desktop UI talks to. It listens on `127.0.0.1:8710` by default.

### Authentication
Every `/api/*` request and every `/ws/*` handshake must present the API token — one secret per user, read from
`OPENDEX_API_TOKEN` or the file `~/.opendex/api-token` (created with mode 0600 on first start):

* `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (preferred), or
* a `token` query parameter — **only** on `GET` requests and WebSocket handshakes (browsers cannot set headers on those).

A missing/wrong token is `401` (HTTP) or WebSocket close code `4401`, before any route runs. Only `GET /health` and, when
`OPENDEX_TOKEN_BOOTSTRAP` is enabled, `GET /auth/bootstrap` are exempt.

### Browser protection
A request that carries an `Origin` header that is not one of the app's own origins is refused with `403` (WebSocket: close
code `4403`); so is a `Host` header that is not a loopback / `*.localhost` name (DNS rebinding). Clients without an `Origin`
header (curl, scripts) are not affected — they still need the token.

### Limits
Request bodies are capped (`OPENDEX_MAX_BODY_BYTES`, default 2 MB): `413` when the declared `Content-Length` is larger, `411` when a
body is sent chunked without a `Content-Length`, `400` when the declared length is not a number. Responses are never cached (`Cache-Control: no-store`).

### Versioning
`/api/v1/*` is the versioned surface. The same operations are also served unversioned as `/api/*` (an alias that tracks the
latest version — what the bundled UI calls). Breaking changes will get a new version prefix.

### Not described here
Real-time channels are WebSockets, which OpenAPI cannot describe: `/ws/events` (JSON events), `/ws/video/{window_id}`,
`/ws/audio`, `/ws/audio/{window_id}` (binary media) and `/ws/input/{window_id}` (JSON touch/keyboard messages). They are
specified in [docs/API.md](https://github.com/Lordof21/OpenDex/blob/main/docs/API.md).

get.description: Liveness only — no device state, no configuration, nothing an unauthenticated caller could use.
The token, for a browser page served from one of the app's own origins (OPENDEX_TOKEN_BOOTSTRAP only).
Lists currently detected ADB devices (USB and Wireless).

schema.title: Response Get Devices Api V1 Devices Get

get.description:
The device list and the bound phone — the same payload every `devices_changed` event carries. The UI reads it
once when its event stream (re)connects and follows the events from there (no polling). In memory: no adb run.

Where bringing the phone up stands — device, the daemon's health check (attempt n of N), services — for the boot
screen. In-memory: it asks neither adb nor the phone (startup_state.py).
Returns the bound device profile and encoder capabilities.

post.description:
Opt-in, manually-triggered empirical measurement of how many
concurrent virtual-display/encoder sessions this device really supports
(see WindowManager.run_encoder_stress_test's docstring).
Wakes the phone panel (through the display-power controller) and dismisses the keyguard.
Disconnects the currently bound device and unbinds the session.

USB -> Wi-Fi (`adb tcpip`) with the open windows. `ok` only once the wireless link is VERIFIED and the session
moved onto it; otherwise 502 and the session stays on USB (see AppContext.switch_to_tcpip).
Switches active OpenDeX connection to the specified device serial (USB or Wireless).

get.description:
Remembered devices for one-click reconnect (Cihaz Geçiş Planı §3), most
recently seen first. ``discovered`` is computed fresh on every call from the
passive mDNS listener — never a live probe, and never attributed unless
there is exactly one paired candidate and at least one live advert (an
mDNS advert does not carry android_id, so a real match can't be proven
without connecting — see mdns_discovery.py and §3.2).

schema.title: Response Get Known Devices Api V1 Devices Known Get

post.description:
Explicit, user-clicked reconnect to a remembered device (Cihaz Geçiş
Planı §7.1 — this endpoint is the ONLY place a known device's `adb connect`
ever happens; nothing calls it automatically).

delete.description: Removes a device from the remembered list (does not touch an active session).

get.description:
The Battery page: health (%, capacity, cycles, first use), the charger (class, limits, real current, ETA), the
temperatures with their state, charge-protection and what this session gave/took. Every figure is reported by the phone
or derived from what it reported (`estimated` says so); a missing one is null — nothing is invented. `ok: false` +
`error` when the phone cannot be read at all.

schema.title: Response Get Battery Health Api V1 Device Battery Health Get

get.description: Returns real-time battery level, charging status, voltage, and temperature.
Returns volume levels across all audio streams (Music, Ring, Notification, Alarm).

post.description: Sets volume for a specific audio stream.

get.description: Returns quick hardware toggle states (wifi, bluetooth, mobile_data, torch, mute, etc.).

post.description: Toggles a hardware state.

get.description: Real physical screen state: `on` is true/false, or null when it cannot be read (never guessed).

post.description: Sets the physical screen on/off (idempotent, verified). `on` in the reply is the REAL resulting state.

get.description:
{status: {enabled, connected, ssid, rssi, bars, tx/rx_mbps, band, frequency, standard, security, ip, gateway,
mac, mac_randomized, network_id, …}, saved: [{network_id, ssid, security, kind}]}.
Results of the LAST scan — instant, shown while a fresh scan runs.

post.description: Starts a scan and returns its results (~3 s).

Joins (and saves) a network with `cmd wifi connect-network`. `state`: initiated | pending | failed — the page
re-reads the status to see the association complete.

Joins a saved network WITHOUT its passphrase (daemon: WifiManager.connect(netId) as the shell). `ok: false` +
`error` (daemon_not_connected / daemon_too_old / permission_denied / failed / timeout) tells the page to ask for
the password instead.

Leaves the current Wi-Fi network and keeps it left (daemon: the saved network is disabled — a plain
WifiManager.disconnect() is undone by the phone's auto-join within seconds). Answers `{ok, sticky}`; `sticky: false`
(or absent: an older daemon jar) means the link was only dropped. Refused while OpenDeX itself runs over that network
(adb over the phone's Wi-Fi address): it would cut this very session. Over the phone's hotspot or USB it is harmless.
Forgets a saved Wi-Fi network by its id (the phone drops it and its saved passphrase). `ok: false` when the phone refused.

get.description:
{ok, enabled, name, devices: [{address, name, kind, connected, battery}], readonly, source, error?}. `readonly`
(source "dumpsys"): the daemon could not answer — the paired list is shown, actions are not.

post.description: bt_result {ok, error?, status?} — `error: permission_denied` hides that action for the session.
Generates a secure QR payload and spawns an mDNS TLS pairing listener.
mDNS güvenlik ağı — hotspot multicast'i güvenilmez olduğunda elle IP:port.

get.description: Detects the phone's IP directly from an attached device or Windows gateway.

post.description:
mDNS bağımsız eşleştirme — QR akışı `_adb-tls-pairing._tcp` yayınını hiç
almadığında (güvenlik duvarı/VPN/hotspot multicast engeli) kullanılan yedek.

get.description: Lists launcher apps installed on the attached Android device.

schema.title: Response Get Apps Api V1 Apps Get

get.description: Retrieves high-resolution app icon bytes from the on-disk cache or extracts via ADB.

post.description: Forces re-extraction and cache update of an app icon.
Refreshes installed app registry against device state.

get.description: Lists all active window sessions.

schema.title: Response Get Windows Api V1 Windows Get

post.description: Spawns an isolated scrcpy session on a virtual display for an app.
Updates display mode (maximized or windowed).
Closes an active window session and frees on-device encoder resources.

Gracefully handoffs an OpenDeX window to the physical phone (Stealth DPI —
density equalization; see HandoffManager.handoff_to_phone).

Brings an app that moved to Display 0 (the phone) back to the PC window
(Stealth DPI — see handoff_window).

Re-runs the AppLock unlock-wait sequence for a window still stuck
behind an OEM lock screen (AppLockOverlay's "Tekrar Dene" button) —
avoids forcing the user to close and cold-relaunch the app after a
failed fingerprint/PIN attempt.
Sets window visibility state (visible, minimized, occluded).
Bumps window z-index to top and updates MRU.
Dynamically reconfigures resolution and DPI of a running window's virtual display.

The user's explicit "refresh this window": a state-preserving restart of the app's PROCESS under the window's
CURRENT density (density_reconciler.py, ``force``) — on Android 11, which has no such API for a shell process, the
in-place activity relaunch. Verified — the reply says whether the app really rebuilt itself.

Hub → "Uygulamayı yeniden başlat": the window's APP is rebuilt inside the same window — a state-preserving process
restart, else onDestroy→onCreate in place (plan B), else a cold start when nothing was running (app_restart.py).
The reply is VERIFIED: ``action`` is what really happened (``restarted`` | ``relaunched`` | ``launched``).

get.description: Zero-Apps ADB XML Element Inspector (Faz 3+ Deneysel Mod).

post.description: Eco Workspace'te (paylaşımlı VD, tek encoder) yeni bir freeform pencere açar.
"Buraya Yolla": telefonda şu an çalışan bir uygulamayı Eco Workspace'e alır.
Bir Eco Workspace penceresini bağımsız masaüstü penceresine tomurcuklar.
Bağımsız bir pencereyi Eco Workspace'e geri gönderir.
Bir Eco Workspace görevinin (task) sınırlarını yeniden konumlar/boyutlar ve dinamik DPI uygular.
Bir Eco Workspace görevini kapatır (paylaşımlı VD, başka üye varsa ayakta kalır).

Kullanıcı bir Workspace görevine bastı: gerçek görev defterle (serbest kip, görünür, kutusu) karşılaştırılır; telefon
ya da OEM katmanı onu kendiliğinden küçülttüyse (yukarı kaydırma → yüzen top, boşta kalma) yerine konur.
status: ok | healed | failed | unknown | absent.
Eco Workspace'teki bir görevin DPI yoğunluğunu ayarlar (AOSP WindowContainerTransaction).

get.description: Retrieves current global project settings.

put.description: Updates settings and applies live quality/audio reconfigurations.

get.description: Retrieves saved desktop icon grid layout for current device.

schema.title: Response Get Layout Api V1 Layout Get

put.description: Persists desktop icon positions for current device.

schema.title: Response Put Layout Api V1 Layout Put

get.description:
{supported, mode, apps, sync}: `supported` is false on Android ≤12 / an old daemon jar (single legacy stream).
`sync` = {supported, offset_ms, pc_output_ms, link_ms, target_ms, late_extra_ms}: the "İkisi" (DeX + phone) alignment.

schema.title: Response List App Audio Api V1 Audio Apps Get

put.description:
The DeX page reports what it measures about its own audio: the output device's latency and how many chunks of the
last window were too late for the common target. The phone and the page then move to a new common target (see
streams/app_audio.py). The fine tune is a setting (`audio_sync_offset_ms` in PUT /api/settings).

schema.title: Response Put Audio Sync Api V1 Audio Sync Put

post.description:
The device's monotonic clock (µs) — the clock of the audio PTS. The page calls this a few times, times each round
trip with its own clock and keeps the quickest, to know which PTS is "now" on its side. 503 when the daemon cannot say.

schema.title: Response Audio Clock Api V1 Audio Clock Post

post.description:
The phone's half of the "İkisi" calibration: test tones on the phone at the instants (device-clock PTS) in the answer.
The page plays its own tone at the matching instants, listens to both with the laptop's microphone and writes the
fine tune (`audio_sync_offset_ms`) from the gap it hears. 409 `not_supported` when this device cannot align.

schema.title: Response Audio Probe Api V1 Audio Probe Post

put.description:
Saves the package's preference (device-independent) and applies it to its open windows, if any. With
`standalone: true` (the Media Center's transfer) an app WITHOUT a window is played on the PC too; the answer carries
`error` when the phone could not carry it out (the transfer is then already taken back). 409 + a code
(`not_supported`: no per-app audio on this device; `internal_package`) when it cannot start at all.

schema.title: Response Put App Audio Api V1 Audio Apps  Package  Put

post.description: Fallback REST touch injection for non-streaming clients.
Injects key events, typed characters, or desktop shortcuts.

get.description: Checks whether Turkish/Q layout setup notice has been dismissed.

post.description: Directs phone to physical keyboard configuration intent.
Marks keyboard configuration as completed for current device.

get.description: Lists current active Android notifications with rich metadata.

post.description: Dismisses an individual notification by ID on both PC and Android phone.
Clears all notifications.

Handles notification click:
- Deep Conversation Navigation: triggers native contentIntent via NotificationInvoker
  so Android navigates directly into the specific chat, email, or screen!
- Smart Window Routing: If app is already open, focuses existing window to avoid duplicate sessions.
- Otherwise launches new app window on desktop and navigates into it.

Direct reply (RemoteInput) is not possible from the shell: a RemoteInput result must be delivered through the
posting app's own PendingIntent, which no shell-level API exposes. The UI offers a reply box only for items the
backend marks `can_reply`; none are today. This route exists so the contract is explicit (501, not a 404).
Forces an immediate full re-sync: the daemon listener's list, or `dumpsys notification` without it.
Invokes an individual notification action button (Media, Mark as read, etc.).

get.description:
Fetches real-time MediaSession state (position, duration, is_playing, title, artist, track_id, art_ready).
`fresh=true`: önbellek yerine telefondan CANLI anlık görüntü (eylem doğrulaması / kapak bekleme merdiveni).

post.description: Executes native MediaSession seekTo to an arbitrary millisecond position.
Executes a native playback action (play, pause, toggle, next, prev) via fast daemon socket or CLI fallback.
Tests the ADB communication tunnel and virtual display responsiveness.
Tests touch input injection permissions (e.g. persist.security.adbinput on Xiaomi/HyperOS).
Tests the 48 kHz stereo PCM audio pipeline, audio routing, and MediaBridge detection.

get.description: Etkin izleme kategorileri, seçilebilecekler ve dosya logunun yolu.

post.description: Çalışırken terminalde izlenecek akışları değiştirir (boş liste = terminal yalnızca WARNING+).
Tarayıcı olaylarını backend dosya loguna yazar: 'butona bastım → istek gitti → cevap geldi' tek zaman çizelgesinde.

get.description: Güncel log dosyasının son satırları — 'Logları kopyala' bunu tarayıcı logu ile birleştirir.

Yayın sağlığı: pencere başına kuyruk derinliği ve zincir-koruma sayaçları (resync/skip_ahead).
Sayaçlar artıyorsa istemci gerçekten yetişemiyor demektir — bozuk resim dönemlerinin kanıtı.

One shared, cached sample (younger than ~1 s is reused): polling it from several panels costs one adb round trip.
A figure that could not be measured is `null`, never 0.

Samples of the last `minutes`, the markers on the same timeline, current findings and background command
rates. `active` is False while no phone is bound (the history of the last session is still returned).
The places the file manager starts from: this PC's allowed folders (with free space), the bound phone's volumes, the user's favorites and the PC access level (`folders` | `home` | `all`).

post.description:
Widen what the file manager may browse — PERMANENTLY. Like a grant, only a folder the user picked through the native
dialog counts, so this needs the shell token a page never holds (narrowing, DELETE, needs nothing extra).

delete.description: Narrows the file manager again: forgets a folder that was added before. Only WIDENING needs the shell token, so this does not.

get.description: The user's favorite places.

post.description: Adds a favorite place (a folder on the PC or on the phone).

delete.description: Removes a favorite place by its id.

get.description: Metadata of one file or folder.
Entries whose name contains `q` under a folder: at most `limit` (never more than 500); `truncated` says the limit cut the list.

post.description: Creates the folder `name` inside `parent`; answers the new path.
Renames an entry within its folder; answers the new path.
Deletes each item on its own — to the Recycle Bin / the phone's trash unless `permanent` — so one that cannot go does not stop the others. Answers `results: [{path, ok, …}]`.

get.description: The items in the trash that OpenDeX can restore.

post.description: Puts trashed items back where they were deleted from; one result per id.
Deletes trashed items for good; answers how many were deleted.

get.description: The running, queued and recent transfer jobs.

post.description: Starts a copy or move job (`op`, `sources` → `dest`, conflict `policy`, optional `verify`) and answers its snapshot at once (202); progress arrives as `fs_transfer` events.

get.description: Finished transfer jobs from the history store (`limit` 1–200).

post.description: Removes the finished jobs from the list; answers how many.
Pauses a transfer job.
Resumes a paused transfer job.
Cancels a transfer job.
Answers the conflict a transfer is waiting on: `resolution` (and `apply_to_all` for the remaining conflicts of that job).

delete.description: Removes one finished job from the list.

get.description:
A WebP/JPEG thumbnail, held in the backend's memory. `v` (the file's mtime+size, which the listing already carries) is
part of the URL so an edited file asks for a new one; the response is never stored by the browser either (`no-store`):
a thumbnail is a preview, and previews do not reach the disk.

The file for a preview: images, audio, video and text inline (as a SAFE media type — see fs/content.py), everything
else as a download (the page's document viewers read those bytes with fetch and render them themselves). A phone file
is served from memory (a phone video/audio is read from the phone as it plays), a PC file in place. Supports Range, so a video can seek. Never cached by the browser.

post.description: Opens a file with its default program — never an executable (those are refused with 403 `permission`; use `reveal`). A phone file is copied to a temp folder first.
Shows a PC item in the system file manager (PC items only).

Paths the user dropped or picked through NATIVE UI. Only the Tauri shell holds the token this needs, so a page —
however it got its script — cannot widen what the file manager may read.

AppAudioPatch.title: AppAudioPatch
AppAudioPatch.description: PUT /api/audio/apps/{package}: only the fields present change.

AudioSyncReport.title: AudioSyncReport
AudioSyncReport.description: PUT /api/audio/sync: what the DeX page measures about its own audio — both optional, the page sends what changed.

DeviceProfile.title: DeviceProfile
DeviceProfile.description: Per-device knowledge, keyed by ANDROID_ID, cached in SQLite.

detail.description: A human-readable message, a machine code (e.g. `not_supported`), or — for 422 — the list of validation errors.

KnownDeviceInfo.title: KnownDeviceInfo
KnownDeviceInfo.description:
API response shape: KnownDevice plus runtime-only discovery state that
is never persisted (computed fresh from the live mDNS listener on every
request — see mdns_discovery.MdnsDiscovery.get_live_connect_endpoints).

locus.title: Locus
locus.description:
Görevin şu an yaşadığı ekran (desktop/workspace/phone) — türetilmiş,
saklanmaz; bkz. windows/task_locus.py.

tokenQuery.name: token
tokenQuery.description: The same token as a query parameter — accepted on GET requests and WebSocket handshakes only.

NoDevice.description: No phone is bound to the backend right now (`detail` is the text "Cihaz bağlı değil."). The operation needs a connected device; poll `GET /devices/state` or listen for the `device_connected` event.

Unauthorized.description: The API token is missing or wrong (WebSocket: close code 4401).

ForeignOrigin.description: The request carries an `Origin` that is not one of the app's own origins, or a `Host` that is not a loopback name (WebSocket: close code 4403).

LengthRequired.description: The request body was sent with chunked transfer-encoding and no `Content-Length` (chunked bodies are refused).

PayloadTooLarge.description: The request body is larger than `OPENDEX_MAX_BODY_BYTES` (default 2 MB).
